text:
deploy-bot: kicking off release window for search service, rolling image search:2026-06-15-0923. feature flag `open_search_v2` will start at 1% canary. quiet window 22:00-02:00 UTC, infra oncall enabled. I will post checkpoints.

sam: ack. canary cohort = 1% then ramp to 5% -> 25% if stable?

jia: +1 for 1->5->25. suggest 10m observe at 1%, then 10m at 5%, then 20m at 25%. thresholds: p95 > 200ms OR error-rate > 0.5% => rollback.

michael: please pin search image for canary and note in release notes: pin to `search:2026-06-15-0923` for canary. also adding short rollback runbook.

ops: quiet window confirmed. We'll be in rotation. @michael you'll be primary pager for the window.

deploy-bot: command snippets for ops if needed:
```
# set canary flag
/ff set open_search_v2 --percent 1 --cohort canary
# ramp command
/ff set open_search_v2 --percent 5
/ff set open_search_v2 --percent 25
# emergency drain
/ff set open_search_v2 --percent 0
```

sam: add note: keep cohort sticky for users in experiment for at least 30m to avoid flapping.

release-eng: copying note to release-notes draft: "search: enable opt-in open_search_v2 for canary users (1% -> 25% taper). Pin canary image and monitor latency/e2e ranking diffs."

jia: telemetry checklist done: added `search.latency.v2`, `search.error.v2`, and kpi `search.rerank.delta` to temp dashboard; also created alert: 5m eval, fire if p95>200ms OR errors>0.5%.

michael: rollback playbook (short): 1) set flag -> 0% (deploy-bot /ff) 2) drain canary cohort and scale down new pods 3) revert service image to previous tag 4) monitor for 10m and confirm metrics recover -> postmortem if not. I'll paste detailed steps to runbook repo.

ops: schedule timestamps: window start 6182739450, expected completion 6182743050. We'll keep slack updates every checkpoint.

deploy-bot: canary checkpoint - 10m in: p95=120ms, error=0.12% :thumbsup: ramping to 5% in 2m.

sam: noted. tagging release-notes entry and adding owner @release-eng.

release-eng: added changelog line and a short users-facing blurb about ranking changes; holding internal note about mitigation steps.

jia: moving to 5% now. will validate telemetry at +10m.

deploy-bot: 5% checkpoint: +10m p95=140ms, error=0.18% -> proceeding to 25% in 5m.

michael: adding a quick FYI in the ops runbook: if any backend model 503s appear, trigger immediate rollback.

sam: reminder: if we need to rollback, do ` /ff set open_search_v2 --percent 0 ` first — less disruptive than full image revert.

ops: oncall confirming readiness to execute rollback steps if alerts fire.

deploy-bot: final ramp to 25% complete. monitoring continues. will post final summary after 30m soak.

michael: thumbs to the team — please upload final metrics and any anomalies to the deploy ticket, and we can close window once soak looks clean.

release-eng: closing note: update the release notes with the canary observations and a short troubleshooting tip for partners.
